localization.english: Start a single or multi-player game.
Quit Heroes of Might and Magic and return to the DOS prompt.
Exit this menu without doing anything.
Change the speed at which Heroes move on the main screen.

Change the quality level of the sound.  CD stereo sounds the best, and usually is less of a drag on system performance, because no processing is required.  However, some systems may not be set up to handle CD stereo, so 8 bit sound is the fallback.

Toggle 'Show Path' on/off.  If 'Show Path' is on, your first click on a map location will show the path to get there, your second will start you moving. If this option is off, one click starts you moving immediately.

Toggle 'Show Enemy Moves' on/off.  If on, all enemies moving within your visible area will be shown.  If off, no computer movement will be shown.  Note that this option is automatically set to off during network and modem play.
View information on the scenario you are currently playing.
Are you sure you want to restart?  (Your current game will be lost)
Are you sure you want to load a new game?  (Your current game will be lost)
Are you sure you want to quit?

source_changes: ControlPanel skips null cursor samples and clears each slot after disposal when changing walk speed. The configuration-side walk-speed comparison operand comes first.

Music source uses boolean 0/1; the shared CD enum is 1. The unused DIGITAL_STEREO value is removed. Both option handlers pass a normalized boolean to SetMusicSource. The shared default CD setting consequently becomes 1.

UpdateCPanel maps boolean music source to retained frame and text entries 0/2, preserving all three original English quality labels. Its remote-enemy frame uses direct branch assignments, matching the absence of a ternary temporary in retail.
Four pointer tables and the saved-game dialog use the localization catalog. The three confirmation prompts reuse existing catalog IDs after full payload verification. Original English is preserved.
GrabScreen, SaveGame apart from its text, and CheckCastSpell have unchanged behavior.

configuration_transition.scope: Shared configuration layout and removal of its two obsolete fields. SetGameDefaults instruction/CFG comparison is complete, but its reference identities and source claim are not enrolled here. AI functions have additional differences and remain unmigrated; only the documented slow-video-dependent regions are corrected in this batch.

regions.finding: NWC initializes cdOffset and musicSource=2, detects CPU, selects Canter/slowVideo=0 or Gallop/slowVideo=1.
Buka sets musicSource=1 and unconditionally selects Canter; no CPU query or slowVideo store.
Buka zeroes 0x12c bytes at gConfig before defaults, proving the smaller aggregate extent.
NWC has the two slow-video branches before the AI movement loop.
Buka uses the normal step limit and 0.06 minimum-RV difficulty factor with no slow-video branch.
NWC strategic search range is 60 immediately, otherwise 36 or slow-video 24.
Buka strategic search range is 60 immediately, otherwise 36.
Buka registry reads go from Autosave directly to map offsets; CD Offset and Slow Video are absent.
Buka registry writes likewise omit the obsolete fields.
Control-panel handler cycles music source 0/1 and normalizes its argument.
Main menu caller uses the same 0/1 music source.
